title: [mirroring] Missing type validations in config mirror-session command
author: raphaelt-nvidia
body:
#### Description

Things that are not checked at CLI level in config mirror-session include:
•	Queue is a uint8
•	TTL is a uint8
•	DSCP is a unit8
•	Source and destination IPs have valid IP address format.

What all in the above paragraph have in common is that the HLD of 10/2020 prescribes Yang model validation for them.  There is currently no such validation; there is only this file https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt-common/blob/86c110812583d0132d6504a1e74eb0337f521fde/cvl/testdata/schema/sonic-mirror-session.yang which Broadcom plan to update.  In the meantime, these are not checked at the CLI level, causing orchagent to log errors and the command goes no further.

Do we want to add CLI-level type validation, integrate the Yang model, or both?

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:

1. config mirror_session span add ms3 Ethernet12 Ethernet16 rx ajdh
2. config mirror_session erspan add ms6 40.0.0.1 40.0.0.2 63 256 100 4 Ethernet136 tx
3. config mirror_session erspan add ms6 40.0.0.1 40.0.0.2 64 255 100 4 Ethernet136 tx
4. config mirror_session erspan add ms7 401.0.0.1 40.0.0.2 3 10 "" "" Ethernet132 tx

#### Describe the results you received:

1. ERR swss#orchagent: :- createEntry: Failed to parse session ms3 attribute queue error: stoul.
2. ERR swss#orchagent: :- createEntry: Failed to parse session ms6 attribute ttl error: failed to convert 256 value is not in range 0 - 255.
3. ERR swss#orchagent: :- createEntry: Failed to parse session ms6 attribute dscp error: failed to convert 64 value is not in range 0 - 63.
4. ERR swss#orchagent: :- createEntry: Failed to parse session ms7 attribute src_ip error: Error converting 401.0.0.1 to IP address.

Erroneous values appear in config_DB and show.

#### Describe the results you expected:

Rejection messages at CLI level, no errors in log, and no configuration.

#### What I did
This PR fixed https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/7990

Type and value validation is added for CLI ```config mirror_session add```.
The value range is defined below

| Value| Range|
| --- | ----------- |
| src_ip| Invalid IPv4 address |
| dst_ip| Invalid IPv4 address |
|DSCP| [0, 63]|
|TTL|  [0, 255]|
|Queue| [0, 255]|
|GRE_TYPE|[0, 65535]|

#### How I did it
Add a value validation at CLI level.

#### How to verify it
Verified by UT
